name: Fresh Grilled Atlantic Salmon with Steamed Jasmine Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's at Bear Lake West (Fish Haven, ID)
whyItWorks: Flaky grilled salmon delivers easily digestible marine protein packed with gut-healing EPA/DHA omega-3 fatty acids. Served with fragrant steamed jasmine rice, it is exceptionally gentle on the digestive tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the salmon simply grilled with olive oil and salt, no blackened spices or creamy garlic sauces. Pair with steamed rice and skip steamed broccoli.
